summary: Agent-editable Executable Plugin containing pure first-party media provider projectors.
context_hints: Keep provider projection pure: no credentials, network calls, asset IO, retries, or task lifecycle in this package
Preserve model/provider-specific wire semantics instead of normalizing distinct shapes into one provider-wide payload
Use Model Card parameter ids (snake_case) as canonical values; legacy camelCase aliases are compatibility-only
The stdio entrypoint must emit only clash.plugin result/broker protocol JSON on stdout and the build must be standalone

subdirectories.cards: Declarative user-facing Model Cards. These are source files and are intentionally agent-editable.
subdirectories.src: Pure provider projectors, unit tests, and the credential-free stdio adapter.
subdirectories.contract-tests: Declarative clash.plugin.contract-test/v1 documents executed by the Bridge before activation.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned Executable Plugin exports and least-privilege declaration.
key_files.cards/*.json: Model parameters, constraints, reference semantics, provider routes, and projector links.
key_files.src/projectors.ts: MiniMax H3, Seedance 2, and MiniMax Music 3 fal.ai wire projections.
key_files.src/projectors.test.ts: Provider-shape contract tests that prevent H3/Seedance field collapse.
key_files.contract-tests/*.json: Activation-gating end-to-end ABI contracts, one or more per exported function.
